The CRM Technologies team builds, scales, and operates Salesforce-based solutions that power MongoDB’s customer lifecycle, from marketing engagement and lead management through sales execution, account management, renewals, reporting, and downstream operational workflows.

The team partners closely with Marketing, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Customer Success, Data, and Engineering to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable business systems. The team continuously evolves the CRM and marketing technology ecosystem through automation, integrations, data quality improvements, and platform operations.

Role Overview

We are looking for an Engineer III, Business Systems to design, build, and support the systems and integrations that enable MongoDB’s top-of-funnel and lead-to-revenue processes.

This individual contributor role will focus on marketing technology, lead lifecycle management, enrichment, campaign operations, account and territory management, activity management, outreach, annual planning, and inbound and outbound integrations. You will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions using Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, integration tools, APIs, and data services.

You will own delivery across the full solution lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, and production support. You will also contribute to engineering standards, platform governance, data quality, and continuous improvement across the GTM Technology ecosystem.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and support solutions for top-of-funnel and marketing operations processes
  • Develop and enhance lead capture, lead conversion, routing, qualification, scoring, and lifecycle management capabilities
  • Administer and integrate marketing and enrichment platforms such as FCI, LeanData, Ortoo, and related GTM applications
  • Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, data, and downstream business systems
  • Support campaign management, campaign attribution, audience segmentation, campaign member management, and marketing performance workflows
  • Develop scalable solutions for account management, territory planning, account assignment, ownership changes, and coverage models
  • Design and support partner management capabilities, including partner onboarding, partner data management, partner lifecycle workflows, referral and lead registration processes, partner attribution, and partner communications
  • Build and enhance partner portal experiences that provide secure access to leads, opportunities, campaign resources, enablement content, deal registration, performance insights, and relevant account information
  • Enable activity management and Outreach workflows across marketing, business development, sales, and partner teams
  • Design and support inbound integrations that create, enrich, qualify, and route leads and accounts into Salesforce
  • Partner with Marketing Operations, Sales Development, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data, and Engineering to understand requirements and identify process gaps
  • Contribute to documentation, UAT, regression testing, runbooks, monitoring, and user enablement
  • Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and GitHub Copilot to improve productivity, analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation while applying sound judgment around security, privacy, and accuracy

Responsibilities

Technical Delivery

  • Translate business requirements into scalable marketing technology and Salesforce solutions using declarative configuration, custom development, APIs, and integration platforms.

Marketing Technology Engineering

  • Own and enhance capabilities across:
    • Lead capture, conversion, qualification, and routing
    • Marketing enrichment and data normalization
    • Campaign and campaign member management
    • Account identification, matching, and hierarchy management
    • Territory planning and account assignment
    • Activity and engagement management
    • Outreach and business development workflows
    • Marketing attribution and lifecycle reporting
    • Annual planning and operational planning processes

Integration and System Design

  • Design and support secure, reliable, and observable inbound and outbound integrations across Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, and enterprise platforms.

Data Quality and Governance

  • Establish reliable data flows and controls that improve completeness, accuracy, consistency, deduplication, consent handling, and governance across lead, contact, account, campaign, and activity data.

Engineering Excellence

  • Maintain high standards for modular design, test coverage, documentation, deployment processes, monitoring, CI/CD, and adherence to shared integration and Salesforce engineering patterns.

Platform Optimization

  • Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, integration risks, manual processes, technical debt, and opportunities to simplify the marketing technology architecture.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • 6+ years of hands-on Salesforce development or enterprise business systems engineering experience
  • Strong experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, Salesforce APIs, and platform automation
  • Proficiency in scripting and programming languages such as Python and JavaScript, with experience building reusable automation, data transformation, and integration services
  • Experience with React or comparable modern front-end frameworks
  • Experience with full-stack development, including front-end applications, back-end services, APIs, data models, authentication, testing, deployment, and operational support
  • Experience designing and supporting marketing technology, CRM, lead management, or revenue operations solutions
  • Experience building and supporting REST or SOAP API integrations and data synchronization processes
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, data quality, and scalable implementation practices
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certification required

Success Measures

In 3 Months

Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s marketing technology and Salesforce architecture, top-of-funnel processes, lead lifecycle, campaign operations, integration landscape, and stakeholder environment.

In 6 Months

Deliver meaningful enhancements across lead management, marketing integrations, enrichment, campaign management, routing, account management, or related GTM Technology initiatives. Establish yourself as a dependable technical contributor and trusted partner to Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations.

In 12 Months

Become a trusted subject matter expert for marketing technology and top-of-funnel business systems. Drive scalable improvements across lead conversion, enrichment, campaign operations, territory planning, outreach, data quality, and inbound and outbound integrations while influencing engineering standards and platform strategy.

Description

Do you want to join an innovative team of scientists who use machine learning and statistical techniques to create state-of-the-art solutions for providing better value to Amazon’s customers? Do you want to build and deploy advanced algorithmic systems that help optimize millions of transactions every day? Are you excited by the prospect of analyzing and modeling terabytes of data to solve real world problems? Do you like to own end-to-end business problems/metrics and directly impact the profitability of the company? Do you like to innovate and simplify? If yes, then you may be a great fit to join the Machine Learning and Data Sciences team for India Consumer Businesses.

If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, know how to deliver, love to work with data, are deeply technical, highly innovative and long for the opportunity to build solutions to challenging problems that directly impact the company's bottom-line, we want to talk to you.

Major responsibilities

• Use machine learning and analytical techniques to create scalable solutions for business problems
• Analyze and extract relevant information from large amounts of Amazon’s historical business data to help automate and optimize key processes
• Design, development, evaluate and deploy innovative and highly scalable models for predictive learning
• Research and implement novel machine learning and statistical approaches
• Work closely with software engineering teams to drive real-time model implementations and new feature creations
• Work closely with business owners and operations staff to optimize various business operations
• Establish scalable, efficient, automated processes for large scale data analyses, model development, model validation and model implementation
• Mentor other scientists and engineers in the use of ML techniques

Key job responsibilities

Use machine learning and analytical techniques to create scalable solutions for business problems

Analyze and extract relevant information from large amounts of Amazon’s historical business data to help automate and optimize key processes

Design, develop, evaluate and deploy, innovative and highly scalable ML models

Work closely with software engineering teams to drive real-time model implementations

Work closely with business partners to identify problems and propose machine learning solutions

Establish scalable, efficient, automated processes for large scale data analyses, model development, model validation and model maintenance

Work proactively with engineering teams and product managers to evangelize new algorithms and drive the implementation of large-scale complex ML models in production

Leading projects and mentoring other scientists, engineers in the use of ML techniques

About The Team

International Machine Learning Team is responsible for building novel ML solutions that attack India first (and other Emerging Markets across MENA and LatAm) problems and impact the bottom-line and top-line of India business. Learn more about our team from https://www.amazon.science/working-at-amazon/how-rajeev-rastogis-machine-learning-team-in-india-develops-innovations-for-customers-worldwide

Basic Qualifications

• 7+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
• PhD, or Master's degree
• Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
• Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
• Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is the role:

Elastic, the Search Analytics company, is seeking a dynamic and highly motivated Marketplace Sales Specialist to join our Partner Sales organization to accelerate Elastic's cloud marketplace business across APJ. To excel as a Marketplace Sales Specialist at Elastic, you need a blend of high-level technical curiosity and the gravitas of a value-based sales specialist. Because Elastic isn't just a "product" but a versatile search, observability, and security platform, the role requires moving beyond simple transactions to solving complex data problems.

As a Marketplace Sales Specialist, you will drive co-sell activities with the global cloud partners who are highly strategic to the company’s long-term goals. This role will closely collaborate with Elastic Cloud Partner Managers and the Field teams as well as the cloud partners to drive influenced cloud marketplace revenue. We want upbeat, innovative, and data-driven individuals with a track record of consistent performance.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Accelerate and grow cloud marketplace bookings with Azure, AWS and Google Cloud.
  • Identify new and expansion opportunities for marketplaces by introducing and utilizing ISV co-sell benefits and aligning the sales teams for mutual success.
  • Work closely with our sales leadership on developing, tracking, and reporting on account and opportunity progress with their cloud counterparts.
  • Facilitate and run enablement to the field on the benefits of co-sell in our partner programs with each of the hyperscalers.
  • Build and drive critical initiatives for scale with the Partner Sales team to further activate marketplace opportunities with the ecosystem.
  • Develop a prioritization plan for coverage area based on sales and product team inputs.

 

  • What You Bring
  • Upbeat, self-directed and hard-working business development and partner professional.
  • Experience with selling ISV solutions on Marketplace and ISV Program benefits with one or more of the global hyperscalers.
  • Exposure to and expertise with marketplace private offers and using various funding programs made available by the hyperscalers eg. Proof of Concept or Migration funding.
  • Shown success growing the impact of cloud revenue through co-sell motions with sales teams.
  • Ability to prioritize across a wide territory and handle diverse sets of collaborators.
  • AI mentality: Use New Technologies for performance advantage and deal structuring
  • Understanding of analytics, search, or big data markets / products or ability to learn quickly
  • Willing to travel up to 10% of the time.

 

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals.
